summary: The local test run-ledger regression accepts nonnegative rounded tree acquisition time on loaded hosts while retaining exact checks for absent slot and stage blocking.

replay.detail: Test assertion change only; no recorded data is rewritten.

schema.detail: The run-ledger schema and production timing logic are unchanged.

rules.detail: The fixture uses its own home, origin-keyed pool and runtime directory. Tree acquisition still measures ticket work, queue inspection and orphan scans, so its rounded duration is not guaranteed to be zero without contention.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the overly strict test assertion only.
